description: A delay line with feedback, a choice of what happens when the feedback overloads, and modulation on the delay time, the input gain and the feedback.

params.text: How much the TIME jack moves the delay time.
How much of the input goes into the delay line.
How much the GAIN jack moves that input level.
How much of the delayed signal is fed back into the line.
How much the FB jack moves the feedback.
Sets what happens when the feedback drives the delay line past full scale: up it clips, middle it folds back, down it goes through a wave shaper.

inputs.text: Moves the feedback, by as much as the MOD knob beside FB allows.
Moves the input level into the delay line, by as much as the MOD knob beside GAIN allows.
A clock to lock the delay time to; a rising edge restarts the delay and the TIME knob is then read as a division of that clock.
Moves the delay time, by as much as the MOD knob beside TIME allows.
Sets where the delayed signal is placed across the stereo outputs.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
